{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRAdhus8ZTg2QmS4nb2T","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountAdd.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add` and the shared account row builder used by every account command. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TextValidation.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add, ledger_app.accounts.account_row |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.validation.code, ledger_app.validation.name, ledger_app.balances.balance_cents, ledger_app.store.open_store, cli.output.write_table, cli.errors |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>` stores a new account and writes its row. It also owns\n`ledger_app.accounts.account_row(db, code)`, which the get, rename, and delete commands reuse.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Command | Arguments | Exit codes |\n|---------|-----------|------------|\n| `ledger account add` | `<code> <name>` (exactly two) | 0 stored; 2 wrong argument count; 3 invalid code or name, or duplicate code; 1 operational failure |\n\n- Registered through `cli.registry.register` with a usage line and exact arity of two arguments.\n- The command validates code (`validation.code`) and name (`validation.name`) first, then checks the\n  code is not already stored, then creates the account. Nothing is written when any check fails.\n- Standard output on success is CSV: header `account,name,transactions,balance`, then one row. A new\n  account has `0` transactions and balance `0.00`.\n- The stdout write is the handler's final act, through `cli.output.write_table`.\n- Failures write nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.\n\n## Shared row builder\n\n`account_row(db, code)` reads the stored account and its stored transactions through the database and\nreturns a list of four strings `[account, name, transactions, balance]`, or `None` when the account is\nabsent. `transactions` is the count of the account's stored transactions. `balance` is the sum of their\ninteger-cent amounts formatted with `cli.output.format_cents`. No floating point is used.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: check whether the account code is already stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-003` — write: create the account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list the account's transactions for count and balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-success ===\nIntent: Adding an account exits 0, writes the new row with zero transactions, and persists it.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\ncode = \"ZZADD01\"\nname = \"Event Float\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [code, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert f(got, \"name\") == name\n=== END AC account-add-success ===\n\n=== AC account-add-duplicate ===\nIntent: Adding an existing code exits 3, writes nothing to stdout, and leaves the stored name unchanged.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\ncode = \"ZZADD02\"\nfirst = \"First Name\"\nsecond = \"Second Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=first)\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, second)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert f(db.accounts.get(account=code), \"name\") == first\n=== END AC account-add-duplicate ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-input ===\nIntent: An invalid code or name exits 3, writes nothing to stdout, and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood_code = \"ZZADD03\"\nbad_codes = [\"zzadd03\", \"ZZ ADD03\", \"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"AB,C\"]\ngood_name = \"Valid Name\"\nbad_names = [\"\", \"has,comma\", \"x\" * 41]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for bad in bad_codes:\n        rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, good_name)\n        assert rc == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=bad) is None\n    for bad in bad_names:\n        rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", good_code, bad)\n        assert rc == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=good_code) is None\n=== END AC account-add-invalid-input ===\n\n=== AC account-add-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 with nothing on stdout and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ZZADD04\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for args in ((\"account\", \"add\"), (\"account\", \"add\", code), (\"account\", \"add\", code, \"A\", \"B\")):\n        rc, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        assert rc == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(err.strip().splitlines()) == 1\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC account-add-usage ===\n\n=== AC account-row-builder ===\nIntent: account_row computes the transaction count and balance from stored transactions and returns None for an absent account.\n\nfrom ledger_app.accounts import account_row\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ZZADD05\"\nname = \"Row Builder\"\ncat = \"ZZADDC5\"\nfirst_id = 900001001\namounts = [1000, -250]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Row Category\")\n    assert account_row(db, code) == [code, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=first_id + offset, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=code,\n            category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    total = sum(amounts)\n    text = f\"{total // 100}.{total % 100:02d}\"\n    assert account_row(db, code) == [code, name, str(len(amounts)), text]\n    assert account_row(db, \"ZZADD99\") is None\n=== END AC account-row-builder ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Validation and the duplicate check complete before the first write.\n- Application code reaches the store only through `ledger_app.store.open_store` and `db.<table>.<operation>(...)`.\n- Balances and counts are computed from stored rows in integer cents, never floating point and never hardcoded.\n- A failing command writes nothing to stdout.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Get\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account get`, returning one account row with its transaction count and balance. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-TextValidation.md |\n| Provides | ledger account get |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.accounts.account_row, ledger_app.validation.code, ledger_app.store.open_store, cli.output.write_table, cli.errors |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger account get <code>` writes the current row of a stored account.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Command | Arguments | Exit codes |\n|---------|-----------|------------|\n| `ledger account get` | `<code>` (exactly one) | 0 found; 2 wrong argument count; 3 invalid code; 4 absent account; 1 operational failure |\n\n- Arguments are validated first: a malformed code is rejected with exit 3, never reported as absent.\n- A well-formed code with no stored account exits 4.\n- On success the output is header `account,name,transactions,balance` and one row built by `account_row`.\n- Failures write nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: fetch the account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list the account's transactions for count and balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-get-found ===\nIntent: Getting a stored account writes its row with the stored name, transaction count, and computed balance.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ZZGET01\"\nname = \"Get Account\"\ncat = \"ZZGETC1\"\namounts = [5000, -1234]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Get Category\")\n    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900002001 + offset, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=code,\n            category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    total = sum(amounts)\n    text = f\"{total // 100}.{total % 100:02d}\"\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1:] == [[code, name, str(len(amounts)), text]]\n=== END AC account-get-found ===\n\n=== AC account-get-empty-account ===\nIntent: A stored account with no transactions reports zero transactions.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ZZGET02\"\nname = \"Empty Account\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=name)\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1] == [code, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n=== END AC account-get-empty-account ===\n\n=== AC account-get-absent ===\nIntent: A well-formed code with no stored account exits 4 and writes nothing to stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ZZGET03\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\n    assert rc == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(err.strip().splitlines()) == 1\n=== END AC account-get-absent ===\n\n=== AC account-get-invalid-code ===\nIntent: A malformed code exits 3 rather than being reported as absent.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nfor bad in (\"lower\", \"HAS SPACE\", \"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"A,B\"):\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", bad)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC account-get-invalid-code ===\n\n=== AC account-get-usage ===\nIntent: A wrong argument count exits 2 with one stderr line and nothing on stdout.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nfor args in ((\"account\", \"get\"), (\"account\", \"get\", \"ZZGET04\", \"EXTRA\")):\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert rc == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(err.strip().splitlines()) == 1\n=== END AC account-get-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Validation precedes lookup: an invalid code is exit 3, an absent code is exit 4.\n- The command is read-only and writes nothing to the store.\n- Balance and count come from stored rows in integer cents.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountRename.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Rename\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account rename`, changing only an account's name and returning the updated row. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-TextValidation.md |\n| Provides | ledger account rename |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.accounts.account_row, ledger_app.validation.code, ledger_app.validation.name, ledger_app.store.open_store, cli.output.write_table, cli.errors |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger account rename <code> <name>` replaces the name of a stored account and writes the updated row.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Command | Arguments | Exit codes |\n|---------|-----------|------------|\n| `ledger account rename` | `<code> <name>` (exactly two) | 0 renamed; 2 wrong argument count; 3 invalid code or name; 4 absent account; 1 operational failure |\n\n- Code and name are validated first (exit 3), then the account must exist (exit 4), then the name is updated.\n- Only the name changes. Purpose\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` validates and stores one transaction\nand writes the stored row. Account and category codes are valid (`validation.code`); the amount parses to non-zero integer\n   cents (`validation.amount_cents`); the date is a real `YYYY-MM-DD` date (`validation.date`); the\n   memo (empty when omitted) is valid (`validation.memo`).\n2. db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    stored = [f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = (max(stored) if stored else 0) + 1\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, day, memo)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = account row builder used by every account command. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TextValidation.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, ledger_app.balances.balance_cents, ledger_app.store.open_store, cli.output.write_table, cli.errors |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>` stores a new account and writes its row. It also owns\n`ledger_app.accounts.account_row(db, code)`, which the get, rename, and delete commands reuse.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Command | Arguments | Exit codes |\n|---------|-----------|------------|\n| `ledger account add` | `<code> <name>` (exactly two) | 0 stored; 2 wrong argument count; 3 invalid code or name, or duplicate code; 1 operational failure |\n\n- Registered through `cli.registry.register` with a usage line and exact arity of two arguments.\n- The command validates code (`validation.code`) and name (`validation.name`) first, then checks the\n  code is not already stored, then creates the account. Nothing is written when any check fails.\n- Standard output on success is CSV: header `account,name,transactions,balance`, then one row. A new\n  account has `0` transactions and balance `0.00`.\n- The stdout write is the handler's final act, through `cli.output.write_table`.\n- Failures write nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.\n\n## Shared row builder\n\n`account_row(db, code)` reads the stored account and its stored transactions through the database and\nreturns a list of four strings `[account, name, transactions, balance]`, or `None` when the account is\nabsent. `transactions` is the count of the account's stored transactions. `balance` is the sum of their\ninteger-cent amounts formatted with `cli.output.format_cents`. No floating point is used.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: check whether the account code is already stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-003` — write: create the account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list the account's transactions for count and balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-success ===\nIntent: Adding an account exits 0, writes the new row with zero transactions, and persists it.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\ncode = \"ZZADD01\"\nname = \"Event Float\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [code, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert f(got, \"name\") == name\n=== END AC cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\ncode = \"ZZADD02\"\nfirst = \"First Name\"\nsecond = \"Second Name\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=first)\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, second)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert f(db.accounts.get(account=code), \"name\") == first\n=== END AC account-add-duplicate ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-input ===\nIntent: An invalid code or name ADD03\", \"ABCDEFGHIJKLM\", \"AB,C\"]\ngood_name = \"Valid Name\"\nbad_names = [\"\", \"has,comma\", \"x\" * 41]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for bad in bad_codes:\n        rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", bad, good_name)\n        assert rc == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=bad) is None\n    for bad in bad_names:\n        rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", good_code, bad)\n        assert rc == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=good_code) is None\n=== END AC category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    total = sum(amounts)\n    text = f\"{total // 100}.{total % 100:02d}\"\n    assert account_row(db, code) == [code, name, str(len(amounts)), text]\n    assert account_row(db, \"ZZADD99\") is None\n=== END AC account-row-builder ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Validation and the duplicate check complete before the    for offset, cents in enumerate(amounts):\n        db.transactions.create(\n            txn_id=900002001 + offset, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=code,\n            category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"\",\n        )\n    total = sum(amounts)\n    text = f\"{total // 100}.{total % 100:02d}\"\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1:] == [[code, name, str(len(amounts)), err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", \"lower case\")\nassert rc == 3\nassert out == \"\"\nfor args in ((\"account\", \"delete\"), (\"account\", \"delete\", \"ZZDEL05\", \"EXTRA\")):\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n    assert rc == 2\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(err.strip().splitlines()) == 1\n=== END AC account-delete-invalid-and-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The in-use check and every other check complete before the delete.\n- Deleting an account never deletes or alters transactions.\n- Application code reaches the store only through the persistence library.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Post\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn post` plus the shared transaction row formatter and next-id rule. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-TextValidation.md, FEATURE-AmountValidation.md, FEATURE-DateValidation.md, FEATURE-BalanceGuard.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-StoreAccess.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn post, ledger_app.transactions.txn_row, ledger_app.transactions.next_txn_id |\n| Consumes | ledger_app.validation.code, ledger_app.validation.amount_cents, ledger_app.validation.date, ledger_app.validation.memo, ledger_app.balances.ensure_non_negative, ledger_app.store.open_store, cli.output.write_table, cli.output.format_cents, cli.errors |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` validates and stores one transaction\nand writes the stored row. The story also owns `txn_row` and `next_txn_id`, which get, amend, delete,\nand transfer reuse.\n\n## Interface\n\n| Command | Arguments | Exit codes |\n|---------|-----------|------------|\n| `ledger txn post` | `<account> <category> <amount> <date>` and an optional `<memo>` (four or five) | 0 stored; 2 wrong argument count; 3 rejected; 1 operational failure |\n\nChecks, all before the first write:\n\n1. Account and category codes are valid (`validation.code`); the amount parses to non-zero integer\n   cents (`validation.amount_cents`); the date is a real `YYYY-MM-DD` date (`validation.date`); the\n   memo (empty when omitted) is valid (`validation.memo`).\n2. The account and the category exist, otherwise exit 3.\n3. `ensure_non_negative` accepts the account's net change, otherwise exit 3.\n\nThe new id is one more than the largest stored `txn_id`, or `1` when none is stored. On success the\noutput is header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the stored row. Failures write nothing\nto stdout, store nothing, and write one diagnostic line to stderr.\n\n## Shared helpers\n\n- `next_txn_id(db)` returns the largest stored `txn_id` plus one, or `1` in an empty table, computed\n  from `transactions.list`.\n- `txn_row(t)` takes a stored transaction (mapping or attribute row) and returns a list of six strings\n  `[txn_id, date, account, category, amount, memo]`, with the amount formatted by `format_cents`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNTS-001` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORIES-001` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-002` — read: list transactions for the next id and the balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-TRANSACTIONS-003` — write: store the transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-success ===\nIntent: Posting stores a transaction with the next id, writes its row, and a separate read returns every field.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\nacct = \"ZZPST01\"\ncat = \"ZZPSTC1\"\nday = \"2026-04-01\"\ncents = 4550\namount_text = f\"{cents // 100}.{cents % 100:02d}\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    stored = [f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = (max(stored) if stored else 0) + 1\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, day, memo)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1:] == [[str(expected_id), day, acct, cat, amount_text, memo]]\n    got = db.transactions.get(txn_id=expected_id)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert f(got, \"date\") == day\n    assert f(got, \"account\") == acct\n    assert f(got, \"category\") == cat\n    assert f(got, \"amount\") == cents\n    assert f(got, \"memo\") == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-optional-memo ===\nIntent: Omitting the memo stores an empty memo and writes an empty last field.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\nacct = \"ZZPST02\"\ncat = \"ZZPSTC2\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Memo Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Memo Category\")\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"10.00\", \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    row = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1]\n    assert row[-1] == \"\"\n    assert f(db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(row[0])), \"memo\") == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-post-optional-memo ===\n\n=== AC cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef f(r, k):\n    return r[k] if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r, k)\n\nacct = \"ZZPST03\"\ncat = \"ZZPSTC3\"\nfunded = 5000\nspend = 1234\nspend_text = f\"-{spend // 100}.{spend % 100:02d}\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Spend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Spend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=900005001, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat,\n        amount=funded, memo=\"\",\n    )\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, spend_text, \"2026-04-02\", \"tape\")\n    print(err)\n    assert rc == 0\n    row = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1]\n    assert row[4] == spend_text\n as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Empty Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Overdraw Category\")\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-1.00\", \"2026-04-01\")\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=acct) == []\n=== END AC txn-post-negative-balance-rejected ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-rejections-store-nothing ===\nIntent: Unknown account or category, bad amount, zero amount, bad date, and bad memo each exit 3 and store nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZZPST05\"\ncat = \"ZZPSTC5\"\nmissing = \"ZZPSTX5\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Reject Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Reject Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    cases = [\n        (acct, missing, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"\"),\n        (missing, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.234\", \"2026-04-01\", \"\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"0.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"abc\", \"2026-04-01\", \"\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-02-30\", \"\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-4-1\", \"\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"has,comma\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"x\" * 61),\n        (\"lower\", cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"\"),\n    ]\n    for a, c, amt, day, memo in cases:\n        rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", a, c, amt, day, memo)\n        assert rc == 3, (a, c, amt, day, memo)\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=tid, date=day, account=acct, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=memo,\n    )\n    stored = [f(r, \"txn_id\") for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    assert next_txn_id(db) == max(stored) + 1\n    magnitude = abs(cents)\n    text = f\"-{magnitude // 100}.{magnitude % 100:02d}\"\n    row = db.transactions.get(txn_id=tid)\n    assert txn_row(row) ==
